questions.question: On a public road, where must you drive?

options.text: Anywhere if there is no traffic
As near to the left side of the roadway as is safe
On the right to see ahead better
In the middle of the road

questions.explanation: You must keep to the left side of the roadway (as near to the left edge as is safe).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.38 (p.27)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Gentle curve to the left"?
questions.explanation: Gentle curve (W202/W203): adjust speed so you can take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W203 (p.25)

questions.question: What is the speed limit for a goods vehicle with a GVM of more than 9 000 kg?
questions.explanation: A speed limit of 80 km/h applies to a goods vehicle with a GVM of more than 9 000 kg.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.29 (p.24)

questions.question: What does this road marking indicate?

options.text: Channelising line (traffic in the same direction)

questions.explanation: Parking bay (RM6): park completely inside the lines.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM6 (p.49)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 1?
questions.explanation: Control 1 is the centre rear-view mirror.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Where may you NOT stop your vehicle on a roadway? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: In a demarcated loading zone, in accordance with the sign
Within 9 m of the approach side of a pedestrian crossing
On the right-hand side of the roadway facing oncoming traffic
Within the railway reserve at a level crossing

questions.explanation: Stopping is prohibited at these places, among others (6.48).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.48 (p.31)

questions.question: You want to pass a stationary bus. What must you do?

options.text: Stop behind the bus until it moves off
Pass with due care for persons approaching or leaving the bus

questions.explanation: Pass a stationary bus with due care for the safety of persons approaching or leaving it.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: You may not stop on, or within ____ of the beginning or end of, any part of the roadway where its normal width has been constricted.
questions.explanation: No stopping on or within 6 m of a constriction of the roadway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.48 (p.31)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Pedestrians may be crossing for the next 2 km

questions.explanation: Gravel road begins (W325): steering is lighter on gravel, vehicles skid more easily and need a longer stopping distance.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W325 (p.29)

questions.question: After passing this sign, you may not use your hooter for ____.
questions.explanation: Excessive noise prohibited (R206): the hooter may not be used for 100 m after passing the sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R206 (p.11)

questions.question: In this automatic car, which control keeps the parked vehicle stationary?
questions.explanation: Control 7 is the hand brake (parking brake).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: This sign means: "Slow-moving heavy vehicles ahead".
questions.explanation: False. Stop/Ry-Go control ahead (TW343): traffic ahead is controlled by a STOP/GO sign; get ready to stop. ("Slow-moving heavy vehicles ahead" is the meaning of W324.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW343 (p.31)

questions.question: Match each regulatory sign shown to what it means.

options.text: Left turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn right)

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R224: Taxis prohibited. Sign 2 is R239: Width limit 2,1 m. Sign 3 is R211: Left turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn right). Sign 4 is R220: Pedal cycles and pedestrians prohibited.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R224 (p.13), R239 (p.15), R211 (p.12), R220 (p.13)

questions.question: Your headlamps must be on whenever persons and vehicles are not clearly visible at a distance of ____.
questions.explanation: Headlamps must be switched on when persons and vehicles are not clearly discernible at 150 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.1.2 (p.16)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Side road junction from the left"?
questions.explanation: Side road from the left (W107): traffic may approach from the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W107 (p.23)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Turn left ahead only"?
questions.explanation: Turn left only (R108): you must turn in the direction of the arrow at the intersection ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R108 (p.6)

questions.question: What is the "overall length" of a combination of vehicles?

options.text: The length of the drawing vehicle only
The wheelbase of the drawing vehicle
The distance from the front end of the leading vehicle to the rear end of the rearmost vehicle
The length of the longest trailer

questions.explanation: For a combination, overall length is the distance between the front end of the leading vehicle and the rear end of the rearmost vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.6)

questions.question: Rear-seat passengers must wear seatbelts if the vehicle is fitted with them.
questions.explanation: If seatbelts are fitted, rear-seat passengers must wear them while the vehicle is driven.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17 (p.20)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Traffic signals ahead (W301): slow down and be ready to stop if the light changes.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W301 (p.26)

questions.question: For a motorcycle with an engine of 200 cm³ or more, the distance between the outside edges of the handlebars must be…
questions.explanation: Handlebar width: 600–800 mm for engines of 200 cm³ or more; 500–800 mm for engines under 200 cm³.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.12 (p.19)

questions.question: Passengers may ride on the roof or running board of a vehicle if it travels slowly.
questions.explanation: You may not permit any person or animal to occupy the roof, any step or running board while the vehicle is in motion.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: A pedestrian crossing at a pedestrian crossing may stop and linger in the road.
questions.explanation: A pedestrian crossing a road shall not linger but proceed with due despatch.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 316(4)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Right turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn left)

questions.explanation: Left turn ahead prohibited (R209): do not turn left at the intersection ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R209 (p.12)

questions.question: How often should you check your rear-view mirror(s) while driving?
questions.explanation: Check rear-view mirror(s) every 5–8 seconds and on approach to any hazard.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 5 (p.21)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Steep descent ahead"?
questions.explanation: Steep descent (W323): allow for a longer stopping distance, especially when heavily laden.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W323 (p.28)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Towed vehicles prohibited (no towing beyond this sign)"?
questions.explanation: Towed vehicles prohibited (R240): do not enter if you are towing another vehicle or trailer.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R240 (p.15)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn left at the next intersection
Pass to the left of the obstruction

questions.explanation: Keep left (R103): pass to the left of the obstruction, such as a traffic island.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R103 (p.6)

questions.question: Which sign means: "End of dual roadway"?
questions.explanation: End of dual roadway (W116/W117): the one-way roadway ends and oncoming vehicles will share your carriageway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W116 (p.24)

questions.question: When you stop on a steep incline and want to prevent the car from rolling backwards, which control do you use?
questions.explanation: The hand brake (7) prevents the vehicle from rolling backwards.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.11 Sample questions (p.15)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Reduced visibility (W354): fog or smoke may reduce visibility.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W354 (p.32)

questions.question: What must you do when a pedestrian is crossing the roadway within a pedestrian crossing?

options.text: Continue if the pedestrian is not in your lane
Yield right of way, slowing down or stopping if necessary

questions.explanation: Yield right of way to a pedestrian crossing within a pedestrian crossing, slowing down or stopping if necessary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.53 (p.34)

questions.question: What may you not do in the area marked like this?

options.text: Stop, park or drive over it (except on an officer's orders, to avoid a collision or in an emergency)

questions.explanation: Painted island (RM5): do not stop, park or drive over the island unless ordered by an officer, to avoid a collision or in an emergency.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM5 (p.49)

questions.question: Match each learner's licence code to its minimum age.
questions.explanation: Minimum ages: code 1 – 16; code 2 – 17; code 3 – 18.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: After an accident you may take an alcoholic drink to calm your nerves before reporting it.
questions.explanation: You may not take intoxicating liquor or narcotic drugs before reporting the accident, except on a medical practitioner's instructions.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.62 (p.37)

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Do not pass to the right of the sign
Do not pass to the left of the sign

questions.explanation: Danger plates (W401): do not pass to the right of W401.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W401 (p.33)

questions.question: Link each regulatory sign with its correct meaning.
questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R241: Hawkers prohibited. Sign 2 is R229: Goods vehicles prohibited. Sign 3 is R201: Speed limit 100 km/h. Sign 4 is R225: Minibuses prohibited.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R241 (p.15), R229 (p.14), R201 (p.11), R225 (p.13)

questions.question: After an accident, what are your duties? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Leave the scene once you have phoned your insurer
Give your name and address to a person with reasonable grounds to ask
Ascertain the nature and extent of any injuries
Render assistance to injured persons as far as you are able

questions.explanation: Duties after an accident include stopping, checking injuries, helping the injured, checking damage and giving your details when reasonably requested.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.62 (p.37)

questions.question: Tap the hand brake (parking brake) in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The hand brake (parking brake) is control 7.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: When may you stop on a freeway? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: For a reason beyond your control
When a road traffic sign or traffic officer directs you to
In an area reserved for stopping or parking

questions.explanation: Stopping on a freeway is only allowed on a sign/officer direction, in a reserved stopping area, or for a reason beyond your control.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.56 (p.35)

questions.question: Under which conditions may you drive on the shoulder of a road? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Whenever you want to drive slower than other traffic
On a road with one lane in each direction
At night to let traffic pass

questions.explanation: Shoulder use: only from sunrise to sunset, on a road with one lane for each direction, while being overtaken, if safe, and with clear visibility of at least 150 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.39 (p.28)

questions.question: A heavy motor vehicle may not be used on a public road if… (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Its fuel tank is half full
Its fuel pipes are defective and dangerous
Its fuel tank has no effective cap
Its battery and wiring are not properly insulated

questions.explanation: A vehicle may not be used if its fuel system is defective or exposed, the tank lacks an effective cap, or wiring/battery are a source of danger.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.66 (p.38)

questions.question: When must you retract your arm after giving a hand signal?

options.text: Only once the turn has been completed
In good time, before braking, gear selection or steering
When the vehicle behind flashes its lights

questions.explanation: Retract the arm in good time and replace the hand on the steering wheel before braking, gear selection or steering.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 8 (p.24)

questions.question: Which vehicles may enter the area marked by this sign? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Pedestrian priority (R5) limits other traffic to emergency vehicles, vehicles loading and off-loading goods, and maintenance vehicles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R5 (p.5)

questions.question: This sign means: "Hairpin bend to the right".
questions.explanation: Hairpin bend (W206/W207): a very sharp U-shaped curve ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W206 (p.25)

questions.question: This sign means: "Road narrows from both sides".
questions.explanation: False. Loose stones (TW338): oncoming vehicles could throw up stones; braking and turning may be affected. ("Road narrows from both sides" is the meaning of W328.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW338 (p.30)

questions.question: Which sign means: "One-vehicle-width structure ahead"?
questions.explanation: One vehicle width structure (W327): only one vehicle can pass at a time; stop at least 6 m from the structure and yield.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W327 (p.29)

questions.question: Pedestrians may walk on a freeway if they keep to the shoulder.
questions.explanation: No person shall be on a freeway on foot under normal circumstances.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.56 (p.35)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Temporary STOP/GO control: you may proceed with caution
Pedestrian priority area (max 15 km/h for permitted vehicles)

questions.explanation: Stop sign: bring your vehicle to a complete stop behind the stop line (or in line with the sign if there is no line) and proceed only when it is safe.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1 (p.4)

questions.question: Which number shows the horn in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The horn is number 11.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Which control would you use to look at what is on the right-hand rear side of your vehicle?
questions.explanation: The left and right rear-view mirrors (3).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: You should turn the steering wheel while the vehicle is stationary.
questions.explanation: Do not turn the steering wheel whilst the vehicle is stationary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 14 (p.30)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Unauthorised vehicles prohibited"?
questions.explanation: Unauthorised vehicles prohibited (R208): do not proceed past the sign without special permission.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R208 (p.12)

questions.question: Which number shows the window wiper in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The window wiper is number 2.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 11?
questions.explanation: Control 11 is the horn.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: In which position should your hands be on the steering wheel?
questions.explanation: Position hands in a ten-to-two or quarter-to-three position with palms and thumbs on the circumference of the wheel.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 14 (p.30)

questions.question: What is a "motor quadrucycle"?

options.text: A four-wheeled motor vehicle (not a tractor) designed to be driven with motorcycle-type controls

questions.explanation: "Motor quadrucycle" means a motor vehicle, other than a tractor, with four wheels designed to be driven by the type of controls usually fitted to a motorcycle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: What does the yellow background of this sign indicate?

options.text: It is a temporary sign (e.g. at road works)
It applies to heavy vehicles only

questions.explanation: Temporary signs carry a "T" prefix (e.g. TW336) and are shown on a yellow background.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW336 (p.30); NaTIS/DoT Road Traffic Signs chart (sheet of temporary signs)

questions.question: Two motorcyclists riding together may overtake another vehicle at the same time.
questions.explanation: Two or more persons riding motorcycles shall not overtake another vehicle at the same time.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Winding road (first bend to the right)
Lane ends: the right-hand lane ends

questions.explanation: Concealed driveway (W216–W218): a driveway joins where you cannot easily see the traffic using it.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W216 (p.26)

questions.question: It is compulsory to use your direction indicators when changing lanes.
questions.explanation: It is compulsory to use direction indicators each time when turning left or right and when changing lanes.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.42 (p.28)

questions.question: The light turns steady amber as you approach. What should you do?

options.text: Stop, unless you are so close to the stop line that you cannot stop safely or stopping would endanger others

questions.explanation: Bring the vehicle to a controlled stop unless it is so close to the stop line that it cannot safely stop behind it or stopping would endanger other road users.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 44 (p.65)

questions.question: Which of these is "acceptable identification" for a South African citizen?

options.text: A valid South African identity document or passport

questions.explanation: Acceptable identification includes an identity document/card or temporary identity certificate, or a valid South African passport.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.2)

questions.question: A code 2 learner may drive only under which condition?

options.text: Only on roads with a speed limit of 60 km/h
Under the direct supervision of a person holding a driving licence for that class of vehicle

questions.explanation: The holder of a code 2 learner's licence shall drive only under the direct supervision of a person who holds a driving licence for that class of vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: Which meaning belongs to each regulatory sign? Match them.

options.text: 3-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R1: Stop. Sign 2 is R3: No entry. Sign 3 is R4.1: One-way roadway to the left. Sign 4 is R1.3: 3-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R1 (p.4), R3 (p.5), R4.1 (p.5), R1.3 (p.4)

questions.question: Which vehicles must carry at least one emergency warning sign (triangle)? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: Heavy vehicles (GVM over 3 500 kg), all goods vehicles, minibuses and buses must carry a warning sign; motor cars, ambulances and motorcycles are excluded.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.24 (p.23)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Side road junction from the left

questions.explanation: Side road from the left (W107): traffic may approach from the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.1 W107 (p.23)

questions.question: The owner of a vehicle may let an unlicensed person drive the vehicle on a public road.
questions.explanation: No owner or person in charge may permit another person to drive unless that person is licensed to drive the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.6 (p.14)

questions.question: Match each vehicle type to the number of persons (including the driver) it is designed to carry.
questions.explanation: Motor car ≤9; minibus 10–16; midibus 17–35 (a sub-category of bus, which carries more than 16).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.3); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.5)

questions.question: Match each exclusive parking bay marking (RM7) to its meaning.
questions.explanation: RM7 letters: CD diplomatic, MB minibus, D defence force, P SAPS.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM7 (p.50)

questions.question: You may leave the engine of your car running while it is stationary and unattended.
questions.explanation: You may not cause or allow the engine to run while the motor vehicle is stationary and unattended.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: When a motorcyclist moves off, what must be avoided? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Placing both feet on the footpegs

questions.explanation: Move off without lifting the front wheel and without causing the wheel to spin; place both feet on the footpegs as soon as the motorcycle starts moving.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 12 (p.29)

questions.question: At an uncontrolled block pedestrian crossing, you must look left and right for pedestrians crossing or intending to cross.
questions.explanation: On approach, look left and right for pedestrians crossing or intending to cross.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 46 (p.67)

questions.question: What is the clutch used for?

options.text: To increase the speed of the vehicle
To engage or disengage a gear and to avoid stalling just before stopping
To advise other road users of your intention to turn or change direction

questions.explanation: The clutch is used to engage or disengage a gear and to avoid stalling just before stopping.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: How should the interior rear-view mirror be adjusted?

options.text: To give the most complete picture of the traffic behind through the rear window
Pointing at the left side mirror

questions.explanation: Adjust the interior mirror to give the most complete picture of the traffic situation to the rear through the rear window.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Maximum rear-view vision (p.82)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Reserved for vehicles of disabled persons

questions.explanation: Motor car reservation (R308).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R308 (p.17)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Road works ahead"?
questions.explanation: Road works (TW336): temporary construction or maintenance ahead; look out for people regulating traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 TW336 (p.30)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Roundabout: move clockwise and yield to traffic from the right

questions.explanation: Animal-drawn vehicles only (R131).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R131 (p.9)

questions.question: Using direction indicators within an intersection should be avoided unless necessary.
questions.explanation: Use of direction indicators or hand signals within an intersection should be avoided unless necessary.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 6 (p.22)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Falling rocks from the right".
questions.explanation: Falling rocks (W335): rocks could fall from the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W335 (p.30)

questions.question: What is the "verge" of a road?

options.text: The paved part used by vehicles
The middle of a dual carriageway
The portion of the road, including the sidewalk, which is not the roadway or the shoulder
The yellow line at the edge

questions.explanation: "Verge" means the portion of a road, including the sidewalk, which is not the roadway or the shoulder.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.9)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Motor cars only"?
questions.explanation: Motor cars only (R117): only motor cars may use this road or part of the road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R117 (p.7)

questions.question: A learner's licence is valid for ____ from the date of the test.
questions.explanation: A learner's licence is valid for 24 months from the day of the test.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians may be crossing for the next 2 km

questions.explanation: Falling rocks (W335): rocks could fall from the right.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W335 (p.30)

questions.question: Match each control in this automatic car to its name.
questions.explanation: 6 = gear lever, 7 = parking brake, 9 = brake, 10 = accelerator.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: To keep a parked vehicle stationary you use the ____.
questions.explanation: The hand brake (7) keeps the vehicle stationary after parking.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Gears should, where possible, be changed while travelling on a straight course.
questions.explanation: Gears should be changed, where possible, whilst travelling on a straight course.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 23 (p.44)

questions.question: What is the minimum following distance for a light motor vehicle in normal conditions?
questions.explanation: Maintain a minimum 2-second following distance for light motor vehicles and motorcycles.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.49 (p.32)

questions.question: When may you change from one traffic lane to another?

options.text: Only when you can do so without obstructing or endangering other traffic

questions.explanation: You shall not turn from one lane into another unless you can do so without obstructing or endangering other traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.40 (p.28)

questions.question: A 12-year-old passenger is 1,55 m tall. How is this person regarded for seatbelt purposes?
questions.explanation: A child between 3 and 14 who is taller than 1,5 m is regarded as an adult, irrespective of age.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17 (p.20)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Agricultural vehicles may cross or enter the road

questions.explanation: Agricultural vehicles (W352).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W352 (p.32)

questions.question: What is the general speed limit on a public road outside an urban area that is not a freeway?
questions.explanation: General speed limit outside an urban area: 100 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.27 (p.24); National Road Traffic Regulations, 2000, Reg 292

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 7?
questions.explanation: Control 7 is the hand brake (parking brake).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: How does a motorcyclist signal a right turn by hand?

options.text: Right arm extended horizontally sideways from the shoulder, palm facing forward
Left arm moving in a circle
Nodding the head to the right

questions.explanation: MC Module 8: extend the right arm horizontally sideways from the shoulder, with palm facing forward.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 8 (p.25)

questions.question: In an urban area you may park on a traffic island if there are no other parking spaces.
questions.explanation: Parking on a traffic island or in a pedestrian mall or lane is prohibited in an urban area.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: This sign means: "Sharp curve to the right".
questions.explanation: Sharp curve (W204/W205): slow down to take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W204 (p.25)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Lane ends: the left-hand lane ends

questions.explanation: Lane ends (W215): the road narrows by a full lane from the left; change in good time to the lane that carries on.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W215 (p.26)

questions.question: What is "coasting"?

options.text: Driving downhill in a low gear
Driving with the clutch depressed or in neutral, disconnecting the engine from the driving wheels

questions.explanation: Coasting is driving with the clutch depressed or in neutral; it reduces control and should be restricted to short distances just before stopping.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Glossary – Coasting (p.80)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Reserved for motor cars".
questions.explanation: Motor car reservation (R308).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R308 (p.17)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Steep ascent (W322): the road climbs steeply; be aware of slow-moving traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W322 (p.28)

questions.question: In this automatic car, which control do you use to warn another road user to avoid a collision?
questions.explanation: Control 11 is the horn.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)
